opening.argument: The presentation promotes CloudToken through claimed Bitcoin trading and recurring passive-income returns, stating that “25.104 Bitcoin” is trading for the speaker and returning approximately 0.3 per day, with around 10 passive income per month. It presents the application’s order history and displayed profits as evidence of that activity, while directing viewers to join, take action, follow a link, or contact the person who shared the video. The opportunity is further framed as one “going to help you make millions of dollars,” and the returns are said to be paid in CloudToken tokens. A sampled account screen also displays “Phishing site reported.” That warning is visibly present, but the material does not establish who issued it, whether it is accurate or current, or whether anyone transferred funds or suffered a loss.
